data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was triggered by an API failure (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) in the qwen3-235b model during the file review phase, resulting in an 'inconclusive' status. This is a tool error, not a genuine security disagreement.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b failed to review PKGBUILD and .gitignore due to an LLM API HTTP 400 error.
learnings: Implement retry logic for LLM API calls to prevent transient HTTP 400 errors from causing inconclusive audit results.
